label: Controlled research inputs with a five-collider collision proxy; not a tackle model, not a prediction, and not validation against NFL data.

method.approachAngleDefinition: Carrier travel heading relative to the stationary defender forward axis; 0 degrees is head-on and 90 degrees is side-on. The carrier is yaw-aligned with its velocity and begins 2 m from the defender.
method.policy: Initial approach velocity only; no post-contact motor, tackle-success draw, or forced fall.

physicsResult.policy: initial approach velocities only; no post-launch motor force
